_meta.what: Drawing choices of figure group A (Figs. 1-4) that are not results, in the schema of facts.json (value, unit, precision, meaning, source) so that they can be merged as fig.* keys for numbers_audit.

parity_band.meaning: half-width of the grey band around y = x (Fig. 4a) and around zero deviation (Fig. 4b); a visual guide, not a tolerance

hbond_match_DA.meaning: Fig. 1c,d: a contact is drawn as one of the nine deposited hydrogen bonds when its D...A equals the deposited value within this tolerance (and H...A within 0.02 A, angle > 120 deg)

scan_spline.value: cubic spline (scipy CubicSpline, not-a-knot) through the 7 points of the lower envelope
scan_spline.meaning: grey curve of Fig. 2d; its maximum reproduces facts scan.barrier_spline (asserted to 2e-3 kcal mol-1)

overlay_fit.value: cation heavy atoms (Fig. 2a,b); cell frame with the mean heavy-atom shift removed (Fig. 2c)
overlay_fit.meaning: superposition used for the overlays; the printed RMSDs are the facts pcm/gas.geom.kabsch_cation/_anion and periodic.rmsd_heavy
